value.name: opening night crowd gathers
value.description: A crowd assembles outside the Ravenswood Theater on opening night as programs are distributed at the entrance.
evidence: EXT. RAVENSWOOD THEATER - ENTRANCE - NIGHT (OPENING NIGHT)
The marquee is lit. A crowd mills outside. Programs are handed out at the door.

value.name: diana greets arriving guests
value.description: Diana stands at the entrance welcoming attendees as they arrive for the performance.
evidence: Diana stands at the entrance greeting guests.

value.name: diana thanks bram for donation
value.description: Diana explicitly credits Bram Holloway's seventy-five-thousand-dollar contribution with making the production possible.
evidence: BRAM approaches in a dark coat.

DIANA
Mr. Holloway. Thank you. Your seventy-five thousand dollars made all of this possible.

value.name: bram acknowledges support
value.description: Bram accepts Diana's thanks and affirms his involvement in the production.
evidence:
BRAM
(nodding)
Glad to be part of it, Ms. Crane.

value.name: bram enters theater
value.description: Bram takes a program at the door and proceeds inside the theater.
evidence: He accepts a program and moves inside.

value.name: priya coordinates ushers
value.description: Priya manages the ushers near the entrance, indicating an operational leadership role.

value.name: priya wears access cards
value.description: Priya is shown wearing a blue lanyard with laminated access cards instead of her usual keys, signaling a notable change in access or responsibility.
evidence: She wears a BLUE LANYARD tonight, laminated access cards hanging from it in place of the usual keys.

value.name: poster highlights leon marsh milestone
value.description: A production poster at the entrance emphasizes that Leon Marsh is appearing in his fifth Ravenswood Theater production.
evidence: On the wall near the entrance doors, a framed PRODUCTION POSTER shows the cast list. At the bottom in smaller print: STARRING LEON MARSH IN HIS FIFTH PRODUCTION AT RAVENSWOOD THEATER.

value.name: program identifies playwright
value.description: A guest opens a program that clearly identifies the production as 'A Quiet Machine' written by William Harness.
evidence: A GUEST picks up a PROGRAM from the welcome table and opens it. The credits page reads clearly: A QUIET MACHINE -- Written by WILLIAM HARNESS.

value.name: house reaches full capacity
value.description: The audience finishes filling the theater, indicating a sold-out or full opening-night turnout.

value.name: priya announces readiness
value.description: Priya radios that the house is full and signals that the theater is ready to begin on cue.
evidence:
PRIYA
(into her radio)
Full house. Ready on your mark.
